title: Renormalizing small ball events for branching random walk
summary: Consider a branching random walk (BRW) of depth $n$ with standard Gaussian increments, conditioned on all endpoints lying in an interval of radius $r$ (which may depend on $n$), i.e. a small ball event. We prove that this conditioning results in exponential decay of correlations between the endpoints, with correlation length $O(r)$. Our proof is based on the renormalization group, which in this context captures the effect of the endpoint conditioning on earlier steps in the walk.
